properties.name: Great Pyramids of Giza
properties.description: Monumental tombs of the pharaohs aligned with astronomical precision. The Great Pyramid (Khufu) was the tallest structure for 3,800 years.

properties.name: Valley of the Kings
properties.description: Royal necropolis containing 63 tombs of New Kingdom pharaohs, including Tutankhamun. Walls inscribed with Book of the Dead.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, ongoing excavations

properties.name: Karnak Temple Complex
properties.description: Largest ancient religious complex ever built. Dedicated primarily to Amun-Ra. Construction spanned 2,000 years.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, major tourist destination

properties.name: Abu Simbel Temples
properties.description: Four colossal statues of Ramesses II (20m tall) guard the entrance. Sun aligns to illuminate the inner sanctuary twice yearly.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, relocated from Aswan dam flooding

properties.name: Luxor Temple
properties.description: Temple of Amun at ancient Thebes. Built over centuries by pharaohs including Amenhotep III and Ramesses II. Avenue of Sphinxes connects to Karnak.
